title: SAP Access and Login Troubleshooting Guide
problem: Employee is unable to access or log in to the SAP system.
prerequisites: Corporate network or VPN is connected.
Employee has an active SAP account.

troubleshooting_steps.title: Verify Network Connection
troubleshooting_steps.instruction: Ensure your computer is connected to the corporate network or VPN before opening SAP.
troubleshooting_steps.caption: Network Connection

troubleshooting_steps.title: Open SAP GUI
troubleshooting_steps.instruction: Launch SAP GUI and select the appropriate production or testing system.
troubleshooting_steps.caption: SAP GUI

troubleshooting_steps.title: Verify Credentials
troubleshooting_steps.instruction: Enter your SAP username and password carefully. Check for keyboard layout or Caps Lock issues.
troubleshooting_steps.caption: SAP Login

troubleshooting_steps.title: Check Authorization Error
troubleshooting_steps.instruction: If login succeeds but access is denied, note the transaction code and the complete error message.
troubleshooting_steps.caption: Authorization Error

troubleshooting_steps.title: Retry Access
troubleshooting_steps.instruction: Close SAP GUI, reopen it, and verify whether the issue has been resolved.
troubleshooting_steps.caption: Retry Login

common_errors.resolution: Verify credentials or request a password reset.
Contact the SAP Security Team to review your access permissions.
Verify VPN or corporate network connectivity.

escalation.condition: Escalate if login or authorization issues continue after troubleshooting.

faq.question: Do I need VPN to use SAP?
faq.answer: Yes, when working outside the corporate network.

faq.question: Who approves SAP access?
faq.answer: The SAP Security or Business Application Team.
